caption: Golden-brown, glossy miso broth with noodles and toppings sits in a white ceramic bowl with a glossy, rounded rim. Chashu pork, menma, and naruuto are visible on top against a dark, smooth background with faint edges.

segments_info.text: Dark, smooth, matte surface with subtle reflections and faint, irregular edges around the bowl's base.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, marbled texture with glossy surface and irregular, slightly curled shape.
The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and toppings.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
Naruto fish cake: pink swirl center, white base, scalloped edge, smooth surface with subtle texture.
